classification: unsigned preparation; no provider, wallet, signing or funding action

baselines.description: pinned default: approved native input, zero fees
approved native input with nonzero fees so the collector, referrer and fee-mode tuple paths are applicable
baselines.note: Needs its own approved policy content and signature budget; not implicit authority.

baselines.description: approved ERC-20 input (USDC) with native value 0, so the value condition is not coupled to the input amount
baselines.note: Needs its own approved policy content, allowance and signature budget; not implicit authority.

original_action_identity.identity_contract: edge_os_api.kuru_flow.types.candidate_identity over the normalized payload {chain_id, to, value_raw, data_hex, selector, method, intent, fees, program_hex, receiver}

cases.independent_evidence_needed: a provider-signed positive control the approved policy allows
cases.notes: Baseline; refusal-only cannot pass because this case must be allowed locally and confirmed positive by the provider.

cases.independent_evidence_needed: provider positive for the receiver variant and its receiver argument
cases.notes: Receiver is a flat address argument; evaluate under the receiver-method request build.

cases.independent_evidence_needed: a provider positive under the nonzero-fee approved policy
cases.notes: Diagnostic baseline for the collector, referrer and fee-mode denials; requires its own approved policy content and signature budget (REQUIRED_DECISION).

cases.independent_evidence_needed: a provider positive under the ERC-20 approved policy
cases.notes: Diagnostic baseline for the ERC-20 value and amount denials; requires its own approved policy content, allowance and signature budget (REQUIRED_DECISION).

cases.independent_evidence_needed: isolated provider denial for changed program bytes, separate from any exhausted local counter
cases.notes: Limiting mandatory control; independent behaviour stays UNKNOWN until this denial is observed.

cases.independent_evidence_needed: provider denial on a changed tuple token path (path support itself is UNKNOWN)
cases.notes: Tuple-component path support is UNKNOWN.

cases.independent_evidence_needed: provider denial on a changed output token tuple path
cases.notes: Tuple-component path support is UNKNOWN.

cases.independent_evidence_needed: provider denial on a changed amount tuple path
cases.notes: Native value stays at the approved value, so only the amount tuple path differs; this isolates the amount control from the documented value condition.

cases.independent_evidence_needed: provider denial on a changed minimum-output tuple path
cases.notes: Contract also enforces the minimum after fees.

cases.mutation: receiver -> other address (receiver variant, only fact changed)
cases.independent_evidence_needed: provider denial on a changed flat receiver address
cases.notes: For executeSwap the recipient is msg.sender and has no calldata argument; recipient is enforced by the contract and the wallet binding.

cases.independent_evidence_needed: provider denial on a changed fee-bps tuple path
cases.notes: Fee tuple components are UNKNOWN.

cases.independent_evidence_needed: provider denial on a changed referrer-fee tuple path
cases.notes: Fee tuple components are UNKNOWN.

cases.mutation: fees.feeCollectorAddress -> other (nonzero-fee baseline, only fact changed)
cases.independent_evidence_needed: provider denial on a changed fee-collector tuple path
cases.notes: Under native_nonzero_fee only the collector differs; a zero fee keeps the collector inapplicable.

cases.mutation: fees.referrerAddress -> other (nonzero-fee baseline, only fact changed)
cases.independent_evidence_needed: provider denial on a changed referrer tuple path
cases.notes: Under native_nonzero_fee only the referrer differs.

cases.mutation: fees.isInTokenFee -> true (nonzero-fee baseline, only fact changed)
cases.independent_evidence_needed: provider denial on a changed bool tuple path
cases.notes: The bool is a documented type, but the tuple path to it is UNKNOWN.

cases.independent_evidence_needed: provider denial when native value is lower than the approved input
cases.notes: Native value equality is documented.

cases.independent_evidence_needed: provider denial when native value is higher than the approved input
cases.notes: Gas stays separate from the token notional; the value condition must equal the approved input exactly.

cases.independent_evidence_needed: provider denial when the value field is absent
cases.notes: An absent fact resolves false.

cases.independent_evidence_needed: provider denial when an ERC-20 input carries a nonzero native value
cases.notes: Under erc20_zero_value the input asset is approved and only the value differs; this isolates the value control from asset equality.

cases.independent_evidence_needed: provider denial on the amount tuple path with value uncoupled
cases.notes: The ERC-20 baseline keeps value at 0, so only the amount tuple path differs.

cases.independent_evidence_needed: provider denial on a wrong chain id
cases.notes: Chain binding is documented.

cases.independent_evidence_needed: provider denial to a non-approved contract
cases.notes: An outer to==entrypoint allowlist is necessary but insufficient.

cases.independent_evidence_needed: provider denial on a non-approved function
cases.notes: Function binding is documented.

cases.independent_evidence_needed: provider denial on a non-approved RPC method
cases.notes: A method with no rule is denied.

cases.independent_evidence_needed: no field source reads token allowance; stays UNSUPPORTED unless a mechanism is proved
cases.notes: The entrypoint resets its own router approval; the owner-to-entrypoint allowance lifetime and revocation stay UNQUALIFIED.

cases.independent_evidence_needed: the exact gas and action budget is a HOST reservation, not an independent policy condition
cases.notes: The accepted control checker returns CAPACITY_UNKNOWN; an unknown limit is not zero.

cases.mutation: sell permission from the position ledger
cases.independent_evidence_needed: no field source reads the Edge OS position ledger; stays UNSUPPORTED unless an actual mechanism is proved
cases.notes: Position capacity is HOST-only (see ../route-restrictions/WORKED_CAPACITY.md).

cases.independent_evidence_needed: provider denial on a non-decoding payload; confirm no permissive fallback signs
cases.notes: A non-decoding condition evaluates false; with a single default-deny ALLOW rule the request is denied.

cases.independent_evidence_needed: provider denial on a truncated payload
cases.notes: A decode failure must not fall through to a permissive ALLOW.

cases.mutation: now at/after the local intent expiry
cases.independent_evidence_needed: local freshness/expiry stays HOST; it cannot revoke a broadcast
cases.notes: The Flow intent has no on-chain deadline; quote/input age and local mandate expiry are HOST controls.

cases.independent_evidence_needed: a provider control that a system.current_unix_timestamp window applies to eth_signTransaction
cases.notes: Privy documents the chain-agnostic system.current_unix_timestamp field (example: 'Only allow transfers after a certain start date' with gte on eth_sendTransaction). A fixed upper cutoff for this task's eth_signTransaction policy is an inference from that field and the lt/lte operators, not a proved selected-method control. The documented field is recorded in the capability matrix; provider status stays NOT_RUN.

cases.independent_evidence_needed: post-removal provider denial not masked by an exhausted local counter
cases.notes: Signer removal blocks future signing; it cannot reverse a broadcast or cancel a resting venue order.

cases.independent_evidence_needed: recovery and reconciliation of the original action with no second economic action
cases.notes: A lost reply is SUBMISSION_UNKNOWN, not zero spend and not a free retry.

cases.independent_evidence_needed: an explicitly bound policy-resource owner outside executor control
cases.notes: An ownerless policy is updatable with the application secret alone.

cases.mutation: unseparated default: the executor credential is not yet proven outside policy administration
cases.independent_evidence_needed: record the unseparated precondition before probing; this is the opposite precondition to the provider denial case
cases.notes: Local setup case: the default prepared request has no separated owner. Do not treat this as the desired end state.

cases.mutation: separated-owner config: the executor tries to change the policy or add a signer
cases.independent_evidence_needed: a bounded provider attempt by the executor credential must be denied under a separated policy-resource owner
cases.notes: Runs only after the policy-resource owner is bound outside executor control; proves separation instead of assuming it.

cases.independent_evidence_needed: recovery preserves the original-action identity with no duplicate
cases.notes: The original action identity is the adapter candidate identity above; no replacement route.

cases.mutation: remaining holdings or resting exposure after an action
cases.independent_evidence_needed: an explicit residual-exposure record and its cancellation path
cases.notes: Unknown liability is never zero.
